title: NL2SQL with Iterative Self-Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2610.22968v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bridging the gap between human intent and machine logic remains a critical challenge in data access for non-technical users, yet Large Language Models (LLMs) remain unreliable: they hallucinate schema elements, generate syntactically invalid queries, or fail to capture user intent. These limitations are especially critical in domains such as insurance, where KPIs, regulatory constraints, and legacy relational systems demand high precision. We introduce a multi-agent, persona-driven NL2SQL framework that combines (1) domain relevance detection, (2) schema-grounded knowledge construction, (3) KPI-aware SQL synthesis, (4) syntax-level self-repair using sqlite execution feedback, and (5) semantic consistency checking via SQL-to-NL reverse engineering. translated_title: 基于迭代自我精炼的NL2SQL（自然语言转SQL）
translated_abstract: 弥合人类意图与机器逻辑之间的差距仍然是非技术用户数据访问中的一个关键挑战，然而大型语言模型（LLMs）仍然不可靠：它们会产生模式元素的幻觉、生成语法无效的查询，或无法捕捉用户意图。这些局限性在保险等领域尤为关键，因为这些领域的KPI（关键绩效指标）、监管约束和遗留关系系统要求高精度。我们提出了一个多智能体、角色驱动的NL2SQL框架，该框架结合了：（1）领域相关性检测，（2）基于模式的知识构建，（3）KPI感知的SQL合成，（4）利用sqlite执行反馈进行的语法级自我修复，以及（5）通过SQL到自然语言的反向工程进行的语义一致性检查。与直接使用LLM提示相比，我们的系统显著减少了查询幻觉并提高了语义保真度。该方法在60个查询上进行了评估（其中50个来自HuggingFace文本转SQL数据集，10个……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种多智能体、角色驱动的NL2SQL框架，通过领域检测、模式知识构建、KPI感知SQL合成、语法自修复和语义反向检查五个环节的迭代自我精炼，显著减少了查询幻觉并提升了语义保真度，尤其适用于保险等高精度要求领域。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a multi-agent, persona-driven NL2SQL framework with iterative self-refinement that combines domain relevance detection, schema-grounded knowledge construction, KPI-aware SQL synthesis, syntax-level self-repair, and semantic consistency checking, significantly reducing query hallucination and improving semantic fidelity in high-precision domains like insurance.
